scope: Recovered reference-source pins for the reconstructed dependency recipe; not a byte-identical installed-runtime receipt
vitagl_note: This tree is upstream vitaGL at vitagl_base plus the local patches in native/platform/vita/vitagl/ (0001 to 0036 and 0038 to 0057 except 0037, 56 files; 0037 is the parked alias15 patch and is not in this tree; 0038 no depth/stencil memory for a framebuffer object, 0039 kept render targets, 0040 back end timers, all three off or timers only; 0041 memory sites (MSC_VGL_MEMSITES, off); 0042 display depth without memory (MSC_VGX_DISPDEPTH=nomem) and parameter buffer in main memory (MSC_VITA_PB_LPDDR), both off; 0043 GPU time per kind of scene (vglRtSceneKinds, only with the split); 0044 shared depth blocks for the picture-size targets (MSC_VGX_LADDER_ALIAS, off; the parked alias15 draft was 0037, which stays unused); 0045 write copy into the uncached pools (MSC_VITA_WRCOPY, off; NEON bursts or DMA instead of the word copy, chosen by a start-up benchmark); 0046 uniform copy history (MSC_VGX_VGL_UNIHIST, uni_reuse 2: an older copy of the scene with the same bytes is named again); 0047 vertex program cache MRU compare inline and 0048 uniform copy inline fast paths (exact backports of upstream 6647b18 and 53cc00f, no switch); 0049 display-queue pending limit and AddEntry timing (MSC_VITA_DQ_PENDING / MSC_VITA_DQ_TIMING, off); 0050 free guard for referenced blocks only (MSC_VGX_FREE_GUARD_REF); 0051 texture level-0 copy by DMA (MSC_VITA_TEXCOPY, off); 0052 glFinish without an open scene (compiled only with VGL_FINISH_NOSCENE); 0053 fast store for the intensity upload (MSC_VGX_I8CHURN, off); 0054 cached stream arena coverage (MSC_VITA_VBUF_CACHED, off; every glDraw* entry writes the arena back before the draw, glMapBuffer/Unmap mark the buffer written again); 0026 to 0036 are not itemised here, the last two being 0035 patch timing and 0036 bounded GPU allocation recovery wait (MSC_VGL_GC_PAUSE_MS); the first 25: aligned pool and stats, seed read-through, scene depth/timers, boot shader pack, GPU memory recovery, shader load validation, aniso/framebuffer depth, FBO blit region, robust scene entry, one stream, per-framebuffer MSAA, glUseProgram guard, sceGxm state cache, SAMPLERS_SPEEDHACK units, lazy clear, full-frame GPU timing validity, direct draw, draw caches, render-target result, swizzled bound texture, render-target split, stencil leak, scene-done wait, uniform shadows, exact viewport halves; applied in order with patch -p1). It already includes them. Do not apply them again.; 0057 per-texture anisotropic filter off (vglTexAnisoOff, MSC_VITA_ANISO_SCOPE, off) and tiled render-target colour surfaces (vglSetTiledTargets, vglTexMakeTiledTarget, MSC_VGX_TILED_RT, off); 0056 uniform history cap; 0055 the clear quad of a scissor mask rebuild reaches only the region the mask holds now (MSC_VGX_VGL_MASKCLIP, off; tile region clip around the clear, same mask)

network_dependencies.name: Mbed-TLS_mbedtls
network_dependencies.note: TLS for the HTTPS client (native/platform/sdk/net/np_https*), built into a private prefix by tools/build-mbedtls.py with only the locked upstream non-PSA TLS 1.3 cleanup hunk in a one-file output overlay; the pinned checkout is never modified. See dependencies/mbedtls/patches/README.md. The vitasdk package recipe's net_sockets, timing and platform entropy patches do not apply to this client profile (entropy and clock come from np_https_sys.cpp).
